text_block_list.text:
Orfevre gave me orders beforehand saying,
"Prepare some entertainment while we're out."
Therefore, I've got all sorts of things prepared!
choice_data_list: Our destination is this way!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ho, billiards, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, we've been waitin' on ya, guest of honor~!
Fashionably late, aren't we?
Did you run 50,000 yards to get here?! Yah-yah!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san invited us, sayin' he was hostin' a billiards tournament. Looks like he reserved the whole place.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"First, we were talking about holding a tournament
among ourselves for the right to face Orfevre...
what do you think?"

An entertainment event that draws a crowd without unnecessary wait times—
putting all previous lessons to use, it was a plan into which everything was poured.
I wonder how it'll be received...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. Very well.
Show me you can entertain me to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Extreme... Passive Shoooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! Aiming for a foul right from the start?!
Still, the position of this #1 ball... is pretty rough...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, no-cushion foul.
Second player, Nakayama-san, your turn!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san, 2-ball in the pocket.
4-ball and 5-ball are in too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Brilliant as always, Journey-san. I'll give it my all, treating this as a chance to learn from the best!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected of Elder Sister.
However, Lala is keeping up admirably as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That Golshi, fighting as amusingly as ever.
It seems the outcome of this race has become anyone's guess...
choice_data_list: Would you like some sweets?

text_block_list.text: Seeing that she's happily enjoying the match, I serve her some light snacks. I want her to enjoy a lively, comfortable time without any waiting around!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Mm. Place it over there.
choice_data_list: Are you good on seconds? Just say the word!
Do you want seconds? Just let me know!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Kuh... Hahaha!
choice_data_list: !? I-Is something the matter...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaha!
Heheh... Good grief—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what an extravagant affair.
To gather this many people and even arrange a private reservation.

Her unexpected reaction left me bewildered.
I thought this was precisely the sort of "entertainment" Orfevre was looking for, but...
choice_data_list: Did you not like it...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
No? I actually liked it. However...
it seems you are also misunderstanding something.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Oh? You can't tell?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... In the first place,
why did you search so hard
to provide Orfe with better entertainment?
choice_data_list: Why, you ask—

text_block_list.text:
Previously—I kept her waiting at the cafe for far too long
and bored her. I reflected on that, realizing I must keep
providing continuous entertainment.

"...However, what if I completely misunderstood
the reason Orfevre got so upset back then...?"
choice_data_list: (If it's not because I made her wait, then why—)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You. Follow me.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah!

text_block_list.text:
Did she feel like having a proper meal?
I hurriedly chase after Orfevre
as she heads toward the bar counter.

Even with such a large crowd gathered,
it seems you must have someone accompany you
if you step outside the circle for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What? If you are hungry as well, you may eat. I permit it.

"Could it be that Orfevre...
hates 'being alone'?
Is that why she got so furious back then...?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Make yourself comfortable while we eat.
Tell me some interesting story.

—Always, naturally keeping someone at her side.
Behind that 'kingly' demeanor,
perhaps an unexpected true intention lies hidden.
choice_data_list: Do you... not mind the waiting itself?
Do you... not mind the waiting itself?
Maybe today's little performance was a bit over the top?
(She wants me by her side...? No, that can't be it.)
(She wants me by her side... No, that couldn't be it.)

text_block_list.text:
—Always, naturally keeping someone at her side.
Behind that 'kingly' demeanor,
perhaps an unexpected true intention lies hidden.
choice_data_list: Do you... not mind the waiting itself?
Do you... not mind the waiting itself?
Maybe today's little performance was a bit over the top?
(She wants me by her side...? No, that can't be it.)
(She wants me by her side... No, that couldn't be it.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That depends.
—If I am in good spirits, I shall permit it.

In other words... I simply need to devote myself
to ensuring there are no "dull moments," correct?
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to make every moment worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It is rather peculiar, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well. Strive to do your best.
For now, I want to make our time here today as meaningful and fun as possible. Let's keep doing our best, both with the dinner conversation and running the billiards tournament!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Nay? I am quite enjoying this in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still... your clumsy singing and bizarre appearance were quite amusing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: As long as it is enjoyable, that is enough.

So... as long as I stay by her side and keep putting on
some kind of amusing show that catches her fancy,
everything will be fine... is that it...?

—Afterwards, as the billiards tournament progressed,
I continued to ponder Orfevre's elusive true intentions.

That's probably being way too conceited.
No, there has to be some other true intention...
Thinking that, I sink deeper and deeper into an ocean of thoughts.
choice_data_list: Hrmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Heh... Truly a kaleidoscope of expressions I never tire of watching.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Struggle all you like. Beneath my feet, that is.

—I still don't understand Orfevre's true intentions.
For now, I'll put everything I have into the conversation over dinner
and running the billiards tournament.
